bio.text: Hallie Shoffner is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Arkansas in 2026, having won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.

According to her campaign website, she is a sixth-generation farmer who grew up on a soybean and rice farm near Newport and ran the family farm for about nine years before it closed after the 2024 season.

She holds a degree from Vanderbilt University and a Master of Public Service from the University of Arkansas Clinton School of Public Service, and serves on the board of the Arkansas Foodbank, according to her campaign.
